appearances.whereabouts: traveling with Moiraine and Lan down the Arinelle River to Whitebridge, then entering the town and the inn, then leaving on the Caemlyn Road
appearances.notable_actions: rides with Moiraine and Lan; tries repeatedly to question Moiraine about their plans and the missing Emond's Fielders; becomes frustrated with the Aes Sedai's calm evasions; suggests they pursue the boat; questions Moiraine about Egwene; eats a meal at the inn in Whitebridge
appearances.demeanor: frustrated, angry, stubborn, determined; feels like a child being outmaneuvered by Moiraine; uncomfortable with the oppressive silence of the journey and the atmosphere in Whitebridge
alliances_shown: seeking to find Egwene and the boys from Emond's Field

appearances.whereabouts: traveling with Nynaeve and Lan down the Arinelle River to Whitebridge, then in the town speaking with locals, then at the inn, then leaving on the Caemlyn Road
appearances.notable_actions: leads the way to Whitebridge following an unseen track; senses the Dark One's gaze on the world; dismounts and speaks sympathetically with townsfolk to gather information; detects traces of two of the boys having been in the inn a day or two prior; explains her tracking abilities to Nynaeve; states her intention to find the one she can be sure of finding to the north; refuses to give up hope of finding all three boys and Egwene alive
appearances.demeanor: calm, unflappable, patient with Nynaeve's questions and anger; shows genuine sympathy when speaking with frightened townsfolk; briefly flashes anger when Nynaeve presses about Egwene; determined and hopeful despite the danger
alliances_shown: seeking to find and protect the Emond's Field youths

appearances.whereabouts: traveling with Moiraine and Nynaeve, scouting their path down the river, then in Whitebridge and at the inn, then leaving on the Caemlyn Road
appearances.notable_actions: scouts their route; checks the safety of the path Moiraine chooses; observes the burned buildings and fearful townspeople in Whitebridge; sniffs the air and detects the lingering scent of a Halfman; dismisses the militiaman as useless; speaks briefly to Nynaeve about the danger and suggests she return to the Two Rivers; invokes Queen Morgase when questioned by the militiaman
appearances.demeanor: grim, watchful, vigilant; speaks little but observes constantly; tense beneath his calm exterior; protective but gruff
alliances_shown: bonded to Moiraine as her Warder
protecting Nynaeve though she frustrates him

appearances.whereabouts: being ridden by Moiraine to Whitebridge
appearances.notable_actions: carries Moiraine; Moiraine dismounts from her to speak with townsfolk

relationships.description: Moiraine holds the Warder bond with Lan; they work together closely, with Lan scouting and protecting while Moiraine makes the strategic decisions

Nynaeve is frustrated by Moiraine's calm control and evasive answers; she resents the Aes Sedai's authority and intentions to take her to Tar Valon for training; Moiraine patiently deflects Nynaeve's challenges
Nynaeve finds Lan gets under her skin; she is irritated by his silent observation and his coldness, yet also attracted to him in ways she won't fully admit; Lan treats her with distant courtesy
Nynaeve is deeply concerned for Egwene's safety and determined to find her; she challenges Moiraine about the girl's fate
Moiraine hopes to find Egwene alive and intends to take her to Tar Valon for training because of her ability with the One Power; she does not easily give up young women with such talent
